snippet.title: Bleeping Spaceships MR Trailer
snippet.description:
Bleeping Spaceships MR throws you into a fast-paced bullet-hell where your room becomes the battlefield! Choose Mixed Reality or full VR as you pilot your handheld starfighter through 32 handcrafted stages, dodging, blasting, and upgrading your way to victory.

Available for Oculus Quest.
